description: Defines the PersonState class used for event sourcing state management in Orleans, including properties and apply methods for handling different events.

classes.name: PersonState
classes.description: Event-sourced state class for a person, with properties for first name, last name, gender, and marital status, along with methods to apply different domain events.

methods.name: Apply(PersonRegistered @event)
methods.description: Applies the PersonRegistered event to update the person's name and gender.

methods.name: Apply(PersonMarried @event)
methods.description: Marks the person as married upon the PersonMarried event.

methods.name: Apply(PersonLastNameChanged @event)
methods.description: Updates the last name when a PersonLastNameChanged event occurs.
